name: Telegram Message
description: Structure of a Telegram Message object returned by the Bot API

fields.name: message_id
fields.description: Unique message identifier inside the chat

fields.name: from
fields.description: Sender of the message; empty for messages sent to channels

fields.name: date
fields.description: Date the message was sent in Unix time

fields.name: text
fields.description: For text messages, the actual UTF-8 text (max 4096 characters)

fields.name: entities
fields.description: Special entities like usernames, URLs, bot commands in the text

fields.name: caption
fields.description: Caption for animation, audio, document, photo, video or voice (max 1024 characters)

fields.name: edit_date
fields.description: Date the message was last edited in Unix time

fields.name: forward_from
fields.description: For forwarded messages, sender of the original message

fields.name: new_chat_members
fields.description: New members added to the group or supergroup

fields.name: left_chat_member
fields.description: A member removed from the group
